questions.q: To prevent eye strain when using a computer, you should:
options: Sit very close to the screen
Use the computer in a dark room
Take regular breaks and blink often
questions.explain: Ergonomics suggests taking breaks (e.g., 20-20-20 rule) to reduce eye strain.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: It is dangerous to bring ________ near a computer while working.
questions.explain: Liquids can spill and cause short circuits; crumbs can damage keyboards.
